pages.title: Passive Abilities
pages.text: $(bold)Arcane Strikes$(): +10% attack damage, and the class adds +15% to every magic hit and takes 15% less from magic.$(br2)$(bold)Spell Armor$(): +2 bonus armor from arcane wards.$(br2)$(bold)Mana Shield$(): Resistance at all times.$(br)  Base: $(item)Resistance I$() (20% less damage)$(br)  Faefolk: $(item)Resistance II$() (40%)$(br)Nothing else raises it.

pages.title: The Hybrid
pages.text: This is the only class where stacking Spell Power gear makes your sword hit harder (Arcane Cleave: +1 attack damage for every 50% bonus spell power, at 10 mana a hit).$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Demi-God$(): four extra hearts and Strength on demand. The strongest pick.$(br)$(thing)Orc$(): +10% melee damage and attack speed, up to +20% more when hungry.$(br)$(thing)Elf$(): +5% magic damage and speed for kiting.

pages.title: Offmeta
pages.text: $(thing)Faefolk$(): +30% magic damage and +10% mana regen for your spells. But Arcane Cleave reads spell power, not magic damage, and $(warn)-30% melee$() makes raw blade strikes weak. A skill-expression pick with a high ceiling and a painful floor.
